metadata.title: Ornate Baroque Frame with Central Mascot Portrait

retrievalProfile.description: A central photographic subject framed by a heavy, ornate gold Baroque border against a textured, dark solid-color background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered photograph of a character in a mascot suit sitting on wooden gymnasium bleachers, encased within a highly detailed, circular gold filigree frame featuring cherubs and floral motifs, all set against a dark, textured maroon field.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the high-culture ornate frame and the low-culture mascot subject
Centralized symmetry of the frame against the textured background
Warm color harmony between the gold frame, wooden bleachers, and maroon backdrop
Depth created by the layering of the frame over the photographic scene
coreInvariants: Circular or oval ornate gold frame
Subject seated in a mundane, everyday environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy gold frame acts as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright gold frame, moves inward to the mascot's face, and then follows the lines of the bleachers outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured maroon background provides significant negative space around the perimeter of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the gold frame against a low-value, muted background creates a spotlight effect.

letterConstructionRules: Bold, all-caps sans-serif for primary warnings
Strict rectangular containment for text blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial sans-serif paired with classical serif for a regulatory look.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black and white warning box

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed industrial feel of the warning text.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured dark maroon background. In the center, place a highly ornate circular gold Baroque frame containing a photo of a mascot in a bear suit sitting on wooden gym bleachers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small black rectangular box in the bottom right corner with white all-caps sans-serif text for regulatory labeling.

verificationChecks: Is the gold frame highly detailed with cherubs?
Is the background a textured dark maroon?
Is the subject centered within the frame?
Is the lighting on the subject naturalistic compared to the graphic frame?

mustRedesign: Exact cherub placement to avoid direct copying

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting direction on the subject
avoid: Flat, yellow-colored frames without metallic depth
Smooth, digital-looking gradients in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic luster on the gold frame
Ensure the frame cherubs are distinct and not warped
Verify the maroon background has a canvas-like grain
Confirm the subject is seated and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Portrait + Ornate Baroque Frame + Textured Solid Background + High Contrast Lighting
